items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: "If he isn't there, I'm really lost. Because I'm so used to him getting in the process."

ctx.x: name. Well, we'll ask him. He'll know. Yeah. I can't think of his dad. I just want to get those guys. I can't think of his dad's name. I was going to ask about, in marching, the trombones are always out in front, but where does the tuba belong? Right with you or sometimes the tuba in back of you in the old days? Way back. Two supporters always be in the front. No, no, but some time ago the tuba used to be behind us because if you had two trombones, the tuba used to be back to the second. But now here up late, we…

Well, yeah. I don't know if that... I don't know how Poisey's got that lined up now, but I noticed that myself. He put the drums in the... In the middle of it. In between... Between Paul and then, yeah. I noticed that myself.
In the old days, I understand the drums always in back.
